instruction: That GIMP logo sitting in the empty part of the toolbox is wasted space for me — get rid of it.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc', format: 'sexpr', key: 'toolbox-wilber', default: 'yes' } ] }); return data[0]; }
